entries.raw: * Venezuelan [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Hugo Chavez]] tells the country's army and civilians to "prepare for war" with [[Colombia]]. [http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hlP2MozD95CjZl6e_B6X-kVCZqCwD9BRHBOG1 (AP)] [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2009-11/09/content_12415641.htm (Xinhua)]
entries.text: Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez tells the country's army and civilians to "prepare for war" with Colombia.

entries.raw: * [[Sudan]]'s [[President of Sudan|President]] [[Omar Hassan al-Bashir]], indicted by the [[International Criminal Court]], cancels his trip to [[Turkey]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20091109201736/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=a-muslim-can-never-commit-genocide-erdogan-defends-bashir-2009-11-08 (''Hurriyet'')] [https://web.archive.org/web/20110716052647/http://www.sunanews.net/english-latest-news/6188-president-al-bashir-postpones-his-visit-to-turkey.html (Sudan News Agency)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20090430180521/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1 (IOL)] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/europe/8349678.stm (BBC)]
entries.text: Sudan's President Omar Hassan al-Bashir, indicted by the International Criminal Court, cancels his trip to Turkey.

links.raw: [[2009 Salvador floods and mudslides|91 people drown]]

entries.raw: * [[El Salvador]] declares a state of emergency as [[2009 Salvador floods and mudslides|91 people drown]] from the effects of a coastal low. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/americas/8349333.stm (BBC)] [http://www.cnn.com/2009/WORLD/weather/11/08/tropical.storm.ida/index.html (CNN)][https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/el-salvador-flooding-kills-at-least-40-1.782569 (CBC)]
entries.text: El Salvador declares a state of emergency as 91 people drown from the effects of a coastal low.

entries.raw: * The [[APEC Singapore 2009|21st summit]] of [[Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation|APEC]] begins in [[Singapore]]. [http://www.channelnewsasia.com/stories/singaporelocalnews/view/1016743/1/.html (Channel News Asia)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20091112013020/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/Asia/Story/STIStory_452003.html (''Straits Times'')]
entries.text: The 21st summit of APEC begins in Singapore.

entries.raw: * At least 13 people are killed and at least 35 are injured in a [[2009 Adezai bombing|suicide attack]] in [[Adezai]], [[Pakistan]]. [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2009/11/20091185332446621.html (Al Jazeera)] [http://www.hindustantimes.com/Suicide-attack-in-Pakistan-s-Peshawar-city-8-killed/H1-Article1-474071.aspx (''Hindustan Times'')] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/8348956.stm (BBC)] [http://in.reuters.com/article/southAsiaNews/idINIndia-43780320091108?feedType=RSS&feedName=southAsiaNews (Reuters India)] [http://www.rte.ie/news/2009/1108/pakistan.html (RTÉ)]
entries.text: At least 13 people are killed and at least 35 are injured in a suicide attack in Adezai, Pakistan.

links.target: Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

links.raw: [[Involvement of the People's Republic of China in Africa|Sino-african cooperation]]
links.target: Involvement of the People's Republic of China in Africa

entries.raw: * Speaking at [[Sharm el-Sheikh]]'s [[Forum on China-Africa Cooperation]], [[People's Republic of China|China]]'s [[Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China|Premier]] [[Wen Jiabao]], pledges $10 billion (£6 billion) loans to Africa over a three-year period, in order to increase [[Involvement of the People's Republic of China in Africa|Sino-african cooperation]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/8349020.stm (BBC)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20091111043813/http://www.france24.com/en/20091108-china-africa-summit-egypt-financial-aid-development-beijing (France 24)] [http://www.rte.ie/news/2009/1108/africa.html (RTÉ)] [http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asia/159494/china-to-give-africa-10-bln-in-loans-wen (''Bangkok Post'')]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} [http://news.theage.com.au/breaking-news-world/china-to-give-africa-us10b-in-loans-20091108-i3ki.html (''The Age'')]
entries.text: Speaking at Sharm el-Sheikh's Forum on China-Africa Cooperation, China's Premier Wen Jiabao, pledges $10 billion (£6 billion) loans to Africa over a three-year period, in order to increase Sino-african cooperation. {{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}

entries.raw: * [[North Korea]]n leader [[Kim Jong-il]] sacks a top TV official after [[Korean Central Television|state television]] begins broadcasting advertisements, out of concern that they were "increasing the influence of [[capitalism]]". [http://www.rthk.org.hk/rthk/news/einternational/news.htm?einternational&20091109&56&625267 (RTHK)] [http://joongangdaily.joins.com/article/view.asp?aid=2912303 (''Joongang Daily'')] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/north-korea-judges-tv-ads--a-step-too-far-1817273.html (''The Independent'')]
entries.text: North Korean leader Kim Jong-il sacks a top TV official after state television begins broadcasting advertisements, out of concern that they were "increasing the influence of capitalism".

links.surface: Sharon Commins and her Ugandan colleague Hilda Kawuki
links.target: Kidnapping of Sharon Commins and Hilda Kawuki

entries.raw: * [[Kidnapping of Sharon Commins and Hilda Kawuki|Sharon Commins and her Ugandan colleague Hilda Kawuki]] are awarded the [[Hugh O'Flaherty]] Humanitarian Award. [http://www.rte.ie/news/2009/1108/comminss.html (RTÉ)]
entries.text: Sharon Commins and her Ugandan colleague Hilda Kawuki are awarded the Hugh O'Flaherty Humanitarian Award.

entries.raw: * Thousands of people in [[Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]], [[Japan]] protest, demanding the removal of a [[United States|U.S.]] military base. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/asia-pacific/8349083.stm (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/newsOne/idUSTRE5A70IG20091108 (Reuters)]
entries.text: Thousands of people in Okinawa, Japan protest, demanding the removal of a U.S. military base.

entries.raw: * Police in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] arrest 100 people accused of killing dozens and displacing thousands in a conflict over fishing rights. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090430180521/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1 (IOL)]
entries.text: Police in the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrest 100 people accused of killing dozens and displacing thousands in a conflict over fishing rights.

links.raw: [[America's Affordable Health Choices Act of 2009|health care reform act]]
links.target: America's Affordable Health Choices Act of 2009

entries.raw: * The [[United States House of Representatives]] votes 220-215 to pass the highly debated [[America's Affordable Health Choices Act of 2009|health care reform act]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2009/11/08/health/policy/08health.html?_r=1&hp (''New York Times'')]
entries.text: The United States House of Representatives votes 220-215 to pass the highly debated health care reform act.

entries.raw: * The [[14th Dalai Lama|Dalai Lama]] begins a visit to [[Tawang Town|Tawang]], in the disputed territory of [[Arunachal Pradesh]] in northeastern [[India]], amid objections from [[People's Republic of China|China]]. [http://www.indianexpress.com/news/dalai-lama-arrives-to-rousing-reception-by-tibetans/538791/0 (''Indian Express'')] [http://www.hindustantimes.com/india/Dalai-Lama-gets-rousing-reception-in-Tawang/474149/H1-Article1-474070.aspx (''Hindustan Times'')] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/south_asia/8349010.stm (BBC)]
entries.text: The Dalai Lama begins a visit to Tawang, in the disputed territory of Arunachal Pradesh in northeastern India, amid objections from China.

entries.raw: ** [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] candidate [[Heinz Hofschneider]] and incumbent [[Governor of the Northern Mariana Islands|Governor]] [[Benigno Fitial]] virtually tie in the closest [[Northern Mariana Islands gubernatorial election, 2009|gubernatorial election]] in history. A [[runoff election]] will be held in the next 14 days to determine the winner. [http://www.mvarietynews.com/cnmi-news/local/21571-updated-breaking-news-heinz-fitial-in-runoff.html (''Marianas Variety'')]
entries.text: Republican Party candidate Heinz Hofschneider and incumbent Governor Benigno Fitial virtually tie in the closest gubernatorial election in history. A runoff election will be held in the next 14 days to determine the winner.
